name: Zapret Service Control
description:
Monitor and control the zapret service from the top panel.
This extension is a control GUI for zapret (https://github.com/bol-van/zapret) and requires it to be installed (install guide: https://keift.gitbook.io/guides/linux/install-zapret).

The panel shows a Z icon with a colored status dot:
* green: zapret is running (nfqws/tpws daemon alive)
* orange: zapret is stopped
* red: zapret is not installed

Menu actions allow starting, stopping, restarting, enabling/disabling boot autostart, and viewing a detailed status report in a dialog.

Service control is performed by invoking the zapret init script (/opt/zapret/init.d/sysv/zapret) via pkexec, which triggers the standard polkit authentication prompt. Detection of running state is based on the actual nfqws/tpws daemon processes rather than the systemd unit state.
